sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: rules of the road: right-of-way, traffic signals, warning, railroad and work zone signs
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
Physical page 63 and much of pages 62 and 66 are sign pictures with captions; the dossier names those signs from the printed captions and takes shapes and colors only from the printed text, never from the pictures [A05].
The right-on-red rule is reported with its printed conditions (no prohibiting sign, a stop before the near-side crosswalk and yielding to pedestrians and lawful traffic); nothing beyond those conditions is added [A03].
The manual refers to an emergency phone number on a blue sign at railroad crossings without printing any number, so none is given here [A07].

corpus_stability.reason: The South Carolina Driver's Manual prints a single edition line (Revised 06/2024) on its front cover; its disclaimer says legislative and SCDMV policy changes may make some content out of date until the agency incorporates them, and a possibly newer unlinked upload exists on the issuer site (freshness debt in the run jams), so the corpus is treated as revised at most about once a year, bound to the registered snapshot.
